sources.adaptation: Expose computed value through existing getState bridge; no control replacement.
Exact function copied without changes; import Vector3 from already packaged Three.js.

sources.support: Official registerRenderer documentation defines framedRadius as bounding-sphere size and states fieldOfViewAspect 1.0 is a good default.

adaptations: Synchronous one-root framing for existing static GLB/PLY/SKP preview; omit model-viewer reactive element update, target detach/reattach and multi-model loop wrappers.
Use visible world-space vertices and their bounding-box center; retain all radius, horizontal tangent, idealAspect, idealCameraDistance and adjustedFoV arithmetic.
No model-viewer baked-shadow discovery/visibility changes are applied because this host has no baked-shadow subsystem; supplied visible geometry is framed.
Return null for empty, nonfinite or degenerate framing; getState idealAspect is null when no valid current geometry exists.
Retain host initial orbit vector (1.8,1.2,1.8), five-percent distance margin, near/far limits and OrbitControls ownership.

Before controls start, resize changes adjusted camera FOV to keep geometry framed; after controls start, retain user FOV, zoom, target and position. Explicit reset opts back into automatic viewport framing.
Compute framing once per successful model replacement; viewport resize and camera orbit do not recompute geometry or idealAspect.
Rollback restores old FOV and leaves prior framing intact on render failure; preserve existing supersession, loader, resource disposal and bridge protocol.

Geometry-derived idealAspect remains model metadata for card layout. Camera FOV instead uses Google external FramingInfo documented default fieldOfViewAspect=1, retaining unchanged adjustedFoV arithmetic and radius-derived distance; both camera axes enclose the framing sphere before user interaction.
limits: Static loaded pose only: existing host does not play GLTF animation or recompute framing for animated, morphed or edited geometry after load.
Three.js pinned reduceVertices behavior is retained, including its existing InstancedMesh/skinned-geometry traversal semantics; no alternative geometry algorithm is introduced.
This is an attributed host adaptation of selected official model-viewer framing functions, not a claim that the full model-viewer product is embedded.

reference_tests.method: Execute frozen original methods after removing TypeScript annotations only; compare exact numbers against the adaptation with real packaged Three.js geometry.

selected_product_configuration.layout_idealAspect: Unchanged geometry-derived output of Google updateFraming, passed to card layout only.
selected_product_configuration.camera_recipe: Call unchanged Google adjustedFoV with documented external-FramingInfo fieldOfViewAspect=1 and radius-derived idealCameraDistance. This is a selected product configuration, not the full model-viewer runtime default.
selected_product_configuration.reason: The geometry-derived idealAspect can be below 1 for flat XZ geometry. Using it directly for camera FOV clipped a vertex at an automatic orbit in a portrait viewport (NDC x=1.0071282001524418). Spherical framing protects the retained host orbit and automatic camera rotations.
